figure.title: Figure 7 (continued). Variation with lift coefficient of the aerodynamic characteristics for wing 2. (b) Drag coefficient.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, on staggered scales. Common axis = the M = 0.50 scale: left frame line = -0.1, grid every 0.1 (32 vertical lines, about 62.5 px apart), right frame line = 3.0. The row of labels under the Mach strip reads '0' thirteen times, one under every second grid line from common 0.0 to 2.4, each below its Mach number in the strip 'M = 0.50 .70 .85 .90 .925 .95 .975 1.00 1.02 1.035 1.088 1.10 1.12', then '.2 .4 .6' of the M = 1.12 scale at common 2.6, 2.8 and 3.0 (the right frame).
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D (common to all Mach numbers). Grid every 0.01 from 0 (the top line of the Mach label strip) to 0.21 (top frame line); labels every 0.02 up to .20. The C_D = 0 line is not printed right of common 2.5 (NACA logo box), nor are the vertical lines below C_D = 0.01 there.
figure.content_note: Wing 2 (47 deg sweep, 6 percent thick). One faired polar per Mach number, 13 Mach numbers, hollow symbols with a centre dot, one shape per Mach number: circle 0.50, square 0.70, diamond 0.85, triangle 0.90, inverted triangle 0.925, triangle pointing right 0.95, triangle pointing left 0.975, right triangle with horizontal top and vertical left side 1.00, right triangle with horizontal top and vertical right side 1.02, right triangle with vertical left side and horizontal bottom 1.035, right triangle with vertical right side and horizontal bottom 1.088, D-shape (horizontal top, vertical left side, curved lower right) 1.10, mirrored D-shape (horizontal top, vertical right side, curved lower left) 1.12. Shapes were tied to Mach numbers by following each faired curve to its minimum near its own C_L = 0. Only M = 0.50, 0.85, 0.95, 1.00 and 1.10 are read here. Doubled symbols: M = 0.50 has two circles drawn 5 px apart at C_L about 0.43, above a third circle at the same C_L; M = 0.85 has two diamonds overlapping above a third diamond at C_L about 0.53 (the same triple pattern is drawn for the M = 0.70 squares); M = 0.95 has two triangles 16 px apart at C_L about 0.58; M = 1.10 has two D-shapes overlapping at C_L about 0.1.

calibration.x_definition: Common axis = the M = 0.50 C_L scale (its zero is the second vertical line from the left frame, under the first '0'). Each Mach number's C_L = 0 is the grid line above its '0' label: M 0.50 at 0.0, 0.70 at 0.2, 0.85 at 0.4, 0.90 at 0.6, 0.925 at 0.8, 0.95 at 1.0, 0.975 at 1.2, 1.00 at 1.4, 1.02 at 1.6, 1.035 at 1.8, 1.088 at 2.0, 1.10 at 2.2, 1.12 at 2.4. Reported C_L = common-axis value minus x_offset.
